title: Export lists an untracked part as Not Tracked and the count sheet leaves it out
custom_preconds:
• Signed in as Admin at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • An untracked part with two bins (for example General Storage 4 and A1A 2) and Min 3 / Max 9.
  • Parts > Inventory, Active tab, search that part number.
custom_steps:
1. Click ⋮ next to New Inventory Part, then Export, and open the CSV.
  2. Click ⋮, then Cycle count, then the Print (count sheet) button and open the PDF.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • One row per bin for the part.
  • The quantity column reads Not Tracked on each row (text, not a number).
  • grid_location shows each bin; min_qty 3 and max_qty 9 are still exported.

Step 2:

  • The untracked part is not on the count sheet.
